rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a room, appearance, or hair that is clean, tidy, and well-groomed.

example.jyutping: nei5 gaan1 fong4 zap1 dak1 hou2 kei5 lei5 wo3

rows.note: Use this colloquial praise word when “neat” means cool, excellent, or desirable, as in a car or idea.

example.english: Your new car is really neat!
example.jyutping: nei5 bou6 san1 ce1 zan1 hai6 zeng3 wo3

rows.note: Use this specifically for liquor or a cocktail taken without water, ice, or a mixer.

example.english: I want to drink this whisky neat, please.
example.traditional: 呢杯威士忌我要淨飲，唔該。
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 wai1 si6 gei6 ngo5 jiu3 zing6 jam2 m4 goi1
